text:
matt: Heads up - saw a customer hit double provisional credits today when a canary routing swapped models mid-stream. stream had an in-flight toolcall that got truncated, client retried, and dashboard showed a negative provisional then a big provisional spike. :eyes:
lee: ugh. do we have traces?
matt: attaching router/log snippet i pulled (redacted). small: the important bits are router handing off mid-request + toolcall truncate event.
```
router: route=canary->fallback reason=model_swap
req_id=abc123 session=ssid-77 aff=none
toolcall: status=truncated tokens=142 provisional=true
client: recv_eof -> retry
ledger: provisional_credit(req=abc123, tokens=142)
ledger: provisional_credit(req=abc123-retry, tokens=139)
```
lee: that looks like we treated the retry as a new session. do we not carry session affinity header through handoff?
sam: we do have X-Rdwd-Session but only for hosted->hosted. canary handoff path strips headers right now when we downgrade model group.
nora: that explains the duplicate provisional entries. the console UI currently shows per-route provisional vs committed totals and then sums - it ended up summing both and presented a temporary negative committed.
telemetry-bot: event: meter.toolcall.truncate emitted with fields {req_id, session_id, token_count, route_tag}
lee: proposed fix: 1) preserve X-Rdwd-Session across handoffs; 2) ledger should dedupe provisional credits by (session_id, toolcall_id) for a sliding window; 3) console should show "provisional-delta" timeline to avoid confusing negative flashes.
matt: +1. also we should add a short-term mitigation: when route downgrade happens mid-stream, emit a "handoff.origin" tag so billing can collapse duplicates during reconciliation window.
sam: implementation note: preserving header is cheap but some internal proxies overwrite headers - we need to plumb through our sidecar and the canary proxy config. PR incoming.
nora: UX proposal: add an inline tooltip on the console token waterfall: "provisional: includes tentative charges for in-flight streams. may be adjusted after reconciliation." and add a link to a drilldown showing provisional events for the session id.
lee: telemetry ask: can we emit meter.events with fields: {provisional_id, session_id, toolcall_hash, route_tag, provisional=true} so the reconciliation pipeline can join on provisional_id and collapse duplicates?
telemetry-bot: logged request for new event schema: meter.provisional_credit.v2
matt: action items: @sam add header-preserve PR + unit test for handoff; @lee spec new event schema and reconciliation join keys; @nora mockup console tooltip + provisional timeline; follow-up in #eng-platform-ops if we need a fast rollback.
deploy-bot: a canary deploy at 2025-11-01T15:20:12 triggered model-swap on 3% of traffic - flagged at 2025-11-01T15:21:05.
lee: thanks. i'll take ownership of reconciliation job change.
matt: thanks all, i'll loop in support docs to explain temporary provisional spikes to affected customers.
